Hi Aisha / Ben,

We signed up via the self-serve flow this morning (company: Aurelia Systems) and indicated interest in a Dedicated capacity demo focused on throughput and latency. A few quick details up front so you can triage:
- Expected steady-state QPS: ~100–150 (peak bursts to ~250 for a few minutes)
- Typical input length: 160–300 tokens; average 220 tokens
- Latency target: p50 <150ms, p95 <400ms
- Primary use: high-throughput document generation for internal analytics, some low-latency chat endpoints for agents

I've attached a small capacity snapshot (CSV turned xlsx) and a sanitized API sample payload. Can we get a 30–45 minute walkthrough this week to validate fit and discuss a Mutual Action Plan?

Available windows (PST): Wed 9/20 10–12, Thu 9/21 13–16. If those don't work we can adapt.

Thanks,
Claire Huang

Thanks Ben — answers inline: 
- 100–150 QPS is what we'd like to guarantee for our primary batch endpoint (sustained). We'll have separate short-lived bursts up to ~250 when a daily job kicks off.
- We handle PII at ingestion and can provide sanitized examples; retention policy is standard 30 days for logs, long-term storage in our data lake is masked. SOC2 is in progress, but not required for the initial POC.

Wed 9/20 10:30–11:00 PST works well for us — please send an invite.
